propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket via git blame of the pre-fix state (fixing-commit~1), but only when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact point to a single commit that resolves to a ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer.

A --caused-by <id> CLI parameter allows explicit override of auto-derived caused_by links at close time, and threads through _parse_flags, transition_cli, transition_compute, and transition_lib_writes.

The auto-link writes via _write_link_event directly (bypassing closed-source and cycle guards) after the bug is closed, because add_dependency rejects links from closed sources and the relation is non-blocking and non-cycle-inducing.
Auto-derivation returns None (no link) on any of: no file_impact, no fixing commit found, no >50% dominant commit, or commit does not resolve to a ticket; failures never block close.
The caused_by link edge carries no confidence field; the consuming provenance metric applies classified-confidence semantics to blame-auto-derived edges, not the link writer.
A bug-template blame-hunt advisory in docs/user-guide.md explains when auto-derivation applies and guides users to use --caused-by for ambiguous cases.
